title: Lena and the Ember
author: Juniper Thackeray
blurb: Coral Crane, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
